en: The address joins the making of the world, protection, the all-pervading Reality and incomparable spiritual knowing. Each description adds a different emphasis; none makes the Divine a limited human figure.
pa: ਇਸ ਛੰਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਗਤ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ, ਰੱਖਿਆ, ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਮਿਸਾਲ ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਸੂਝ ਦੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਤੁਕ ਇੱਕ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਪੱਖ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦੀ ਹੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਦੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

rows.en: You are the maker of the world.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਜਗਤ ਨੂੰ ਰਚਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ is read here through making or creating. The line addresses the source of the world; it is not a technical account of the physical process by which the universe developed.

rows.en: You are the protector above all protectors.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੇ ਰੱਖਿਅਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਰੱਖਿਅਕ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ supports images of the protective canopy, sovereignty and the warrior. This draft selects protection; warrior-among-warriors and king-among-canopy-bearing-kings are retained as alternatives, not separate beings.

rows.en: Your being is the all-pervading Divine Reality.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ is read as Brahm, the Divine Reality, rather than automatically identifying the creator deity Brahma. ਸਰੂਪ need not mean a bounded physical body.

rows.en: You are incomparable spiritual awareness.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਮਿਸਾਲ ਆਤਮਕ ਸੂਝ ਦਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: The selected ਅਨਭਉ reading concerns spiritual knowing or direct awareness. A fearlessness analysis also occurs in commentary. ਅਨੂਪੈ conveys incomparability; the line does not require a private vision or certify anyone as omniscient.

study.focus: Let creation, protection, pervasion and knowing remain four distinct descriptions.
study.closeReading: The repeated ਕਿ continues the address from the preceding chhands. First the world is spoken of as made; then the language turns toward protection. The canopy or warrior image can suggest shelter and strength without becoming a portrait of a human ruler. The third line widens the address again through ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰ, while the fourth brings attention to knowing and incomparability. Reading all four in sequence prevents one familiar image from taking over the stanza. The selected awareness reading of ਅਨਭਉ is provisional, with fearlessness kept visible as an alternative. For study, ask what each phrase contributes rather than reducing all four to a single statement that the Divine is great.
words: supreme protector; canopy and warrior images also occur
study.care: The protector image is not a promise that faithful people cannot be hurt, nor authority for a human ruler to act without accountability. The two readings of ਅਨਭਉ need qualified review.
study.reflection: What would protection look like in a small action that respects another person’s dignity?
study.teachBack: Explain the four descriptions separately, then name one alternative reading without treating it as a corrected source word.

en: The One is praised as primal, without a higher master, beyond full disclosure and beyond a fixed portrait. The closing phrase raises the relationship between Divine independence and the dependence of everything else.
pa: ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਮੌਜੂਦ, ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ, ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਆਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ। ਅਖੀਰਲੀ ਤੁਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸੁਤੰਤਰਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇ ਉਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਆਧਾਰ ਵੱਲ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You are the primal One, with no higher master.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਉਹ ਇੱਕ ਹੈਂ ਜਿਸ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਪਰ ਕੋਈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਹੀਂ।
rows.care: ਆਦਿ ਅਦੇਵ is provisionally read as primordial and subject to no superior. Alternative word analyses exist; the draft does not resolve them by changing ਅਦੇਵ or by assigning superiority to a human community.

rows.en: You remain beyond complete understanding.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਸਮਝ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਅਭੇਵ is selected in the sense of an unfathomable mystery. Undivided or without internal difference is another commentary emphasis; a separate digital English rendering uses self-illumined. These should not be presented as an agreed literal gloss.

rows.en: No fixed image can contain You.
rows.pa: ਕੋਈ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਮਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਕਦਾ।
rows.care: ਚਿੱਤ੍ਰੰ ਬਿਹੀਨੈ denies containment in a portrait or defining image. The teaching concerns limits of depiction; it does not instruct learners to damage artwork or disrespect people who use images.

rows.en: You depend upon Yourself alone.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਏਕੈ ਅਧੀਨੈ is read here as self-dependence. Another analysis makes the One the ruler on whom all depend. Both concern Divine independence and sovereignty, but their grammatical directions differ.

study.focus: Recognise limits on description without turning mystery into an excuse to stop learning.
study.closeReading: The first line places no superior above the One. The next two lines limit what a description can claim: the full ਭੇਵ is not possessed, and a ਚਿੱਤ੍ਰ cannot contain its subject. The last line can be read as dependence on the One alone or as the One’s own self-dependence. Keep this grammatical question open instead of hiding it inside a fluent paraphrase. Notice that the stanza still speaks, even while naming the limits of speech and images. That tension offers a useful learning posture: study carefully, say what a reading supports, and remain willing to revise an explanation. The unknowable is not permission for a teacher to demand unquestioning trust.
study.care: Working interpretations are not settled grammar. Divine self-sufficiency should not become a demand that people avoid help, relationships or care.
study.reflection: Where can you say “I do not fully understand” while still staying curious and responsible?
study.teachBack: Contrast a useful description with a complete definition, and explain the two directions in which the closing dependence phrase is read.

en: Daily sustenance and mercy stand beside purity and the hidden mystery of the Divine. The passage brings the ordinary need for livelihood into the same address as what remains beyond our knowledge.
pa: ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਅਤੇ ਰਹਿਮ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਅਥਾਹ ਗੁਪਤ ਭੇਦ ਦੀ ਉਸਤਤ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਡੀ ਸਮਝ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹਸਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕੋ ਸੰਬੋਧਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You provide the sustenance by which life is maintained.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਨ ਚਲਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਰਜ਼ਾਕੈ links provision with the provider. Gratitude for sustenance does not establish that every person currently has enough to eat; hunger calls for practical help rather than judgment.

rows.en: You are merciful and grant release.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਰਹਿਮ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਲਾਸੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਰਹੀਮੈ clearly carries mercy; ਰਿਹਾਕੈ is disputed. Release or liberation is the selected working sense, while the consulted derivative commentary offers enduring youthful vitality. Preserve the disagreement rather than pretending the two are one literal meaning.

rows.en: You are pure and free of fault.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਸ਼ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਪਾਕ and ਬਿਐਬ form a paired praise of purity and freedom from defect. This is not a description of caste, skin, bodily ability or social worth, and it does not classify some people as impure.

rows.en: You are the mystery beyond even what is hidden.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਗੁਪਤ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਗੁਪਤ, ਅਥਾਹ ਭੇਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਗੈਬੁਲ ਗ਼ੈਬ intensifies hiddenness. Both stored spellings are retained. The line gives no technique for obtaining secret information and does not make unverifiable claims by a person authoritative.

study.focus: Hold daily need, mercy, purity and mystery together without erasing their differences.
study.closeReading: The stanza starts close to ordinary life with ਰੋਜ਼ੀ, the means by which one lives. It then speaks of mercy, purity and a hiddenness beyond hiddenness. This movement matters: mystery is not placed outside everyday dependence. The paired terms in the first and third lines make different kinds of relationships, provider and provision in one, two reinforcing qualities in the other. The second line requires special care because ਰਿਹਾਕੈ has competing explanations. The main draft chooses release but keeps the vitality reading visible. An honest explanation can offer a working understanding while naming its limit. The final intensification invites humility, not the claim that a particular interpreter has discovered the whole secret.
study.care: The ਰਿਹਾਕੈ choice remains unapproved. Provision language must never be used to blame poverty or replace feeding and supporting people in need.
study.reflection: What ordinary support have you received today, and how might gratitude become a practical act of sharing?
study.teachBack: Explain how provision and mystery share one stanza, and identify precisely which word has an unresolved alternative.

en: Forgiveness, sovereignty, agency and daily provision appear in four brief addresses. The language of kings is placed next to mercy and food, inviting attention to the character of power rather than rank alone.
pa: ਖਿਮਾ, ਸਰਬੋਚ ਸੱਤਾ, ਕਰਤਾਪਣ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ—ਇਹ ਚਾਰ ਪੱਖ ਛੋਟੀਆਂ ਤੁਕਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸ਼ਾਹਾਂ ਵਾਲੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਰਹਿਮ ਅਤੇ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਵੀ ਹੈ; ਧਿਆਨ ਕੇਵਲ ਦਰਜੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਹੀਂ, ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਦੇ ਸੁਭਾਅ ਉੱਤੇ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You forgive wrongdoing.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਕੀਤੇ ਦੋਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਖਿਮਾ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਅਫਵੁਲ ਗੁਨਾਹ names pardon of wrongdoing. Forgiveness does not make the harm unreal or cancel the need to acknowledge it, repair it where possible and respect the person affected.

rows.en: You are sovereign above all sovereigns.
rows.care: ਸ਼ਾਹਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਹ intensifies sovereignty. It is the Divine address, not an endorsement of a named government, monarch or modern political leader. The original ਸ਼ forms remain as stored.

rows.en: You are the One through whom all activity becomes possible.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਭਵ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਕਾਰਨ ਕੁਨਿੰਦ is read as the maker or doer underlying causes and actions. This devotional attribution does not remove human responsibility for choices or claim that every human act is morally approved.

rows.en: You give the means of daily sustenance.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਨ ਲਈ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦਿਹੰਦ returns to provision after the lines about sovereignty and action. A comparison text has ਦਿਹਿੰਦ; this edition’s ਦਿਹੰਦ is left unchanged. An explanation is not a source-spelling correction.

study.focus: Read sovereignty alongside forgiveness and provision, not as power isolated from care.
study.closeReading: The opening phrase concerns wrongdoing and pardon rather than abstract greatness. The second line then moves to the highest image of worldly rank, only to be followed by the doer of causes and the giver of daily sustenance. Look at how the sequence refuses to leave power as a title. The same addressed One is connected with mercy and the conditions of life. The last line also recalls the livelihood language in Chhand 108, so the link between neighbouring stanzas remains audible. In applying the lesson, distinguish acknowledging dependence from evading responsibility. One can seek forgiveness while also naming harm, making amends and avoiding a claim that Divine agency excuses personal decisions.
study.care: Prayer for forgiveness does not compel another person to reconcile or excuse abuse. The sovereign title confers no political authority on the learner.
study.reflection: What could genuine accountability add to an apology that words alone cannot provide?
study.teachBack: Explain the sequence from pardon to daily provision, and distinguish forgiveness from denial of consequences.

en: The provider is merciful and generous, yet the stanza also speaks of complete power and dissolution. The gentle and formidable descriptions belong to the same address; neither should be removed merely because it is less comfortable.
pa: ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਰਹਿਮਵਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਆਖਿਆ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ। ਕੋਮਲ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਪੱਖ ਇੱਕੋ ਉਸਤਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ; ਅਸੁਖਾਵੇਂ ਲੱਗਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਪੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਟਾਉਣਾ ਠੀਕ ਨਹੀਂ।

rows.en: You sustain all with mercy.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਰਹਿਮ ਨਾਲ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਜ਼ੀ ਅਤੇ ਆਸਰਾ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਰਾਜ਼ਕ and ਰਹੀਮ join provision with compassion. Their relationship continues the two preceding chhands; it is not a guarantee of a particular financial or medical outcome.

rows.en: Your giving is generous and gracious.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ ਦਿਲ ਵਾਲੀ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਹਰ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਕਰਮੰ ਕਰੀਮ is read here through grace and generosity. The context differs from passages about being unbound by karmic action, so the same-looking ਕਰਮ must not receive one automatic gloss everywhere.

rows.en: All power belongs to You.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਕਲੀ is selected in the sense of fullness of power. It is not automatically the name of a deity or the age called Kali Yuga; context and neighbouring praise guide this working reading.

rows.en: You can bring all created forms to dissolution.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੇ ਬਣੇ ਹੋਏ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮੇਟਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਦਲੀ retains the force of breaking or destroying. The main explanation uses dissolution, not a softened claim that nothing painful happens. This Divine description grants no person permission to destroy or intimidate.

study.focus: Keep compassion and the ending of finite forms within the same reading.
study.closeReading: The first two lines bring back familiar words of provision and mercy. The final two broaden the scope to all power and the breaking of what is made. Notice the shift without explaining away either side. If the stanza is read only as comfort, ਦਲੀ disappears; if it is read only as domination, ਰਹੀਮ and ਕਰੀਮ disappear. The repeated address holds them together. This is also a useful place to practise contextual vocabulary: ਕਰਮ in a grace-filled pair should not mechanically repeat every earlier action-related explanation. The lesson invites care in interpretation, not a theory that tells us why a particular loss occurred. Practical compassion remains necessary when someone faces change or grief.
words: fullness of power in this reading
study.care: Do not present bereavement as deserved, infer a Divine reason for a specific tragedy, or turn descriptions of overwhelming power into human entitlement.
study.reflection: How might you acknowledge a difficult change without either denying the loss or abandoning kindness?
study.teachBack: Describe the change of emphasis between the first and second pairs, and explain why neither pair should replace the other.

en: The repeated word for everywhere links honour, giving, movement and dwelling. The address refuses to confine the Divine to one place, while keeping each of these relationships distinct.
pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਲਈ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਮਾਨ, ਦਾਨ, ਪਹੁੰਚ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ, ਪਰ ਹਰ ਤੁਕ ਦਾ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਪੱਖ ਵੀ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You are honoured throughout all places.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ gives the address universal scope; ਮਾਨਿਯੈ concerns honour or reverence. The poetic universal is not a statistical assertion that everyone holds the same belief or follows the same practice.

rows.en: Your giving reaches every place.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤ ਪਹੁੰਚਦੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਦਾਨਿਯੈ names giving or the giver. It belongs beside the honour in the first line, but is not a contract that praise purchases material rewards or proves that resources are fairly distributed.

rows.en: You are present wherever there is movement.
rows.pa: ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵੀ ਆਉਣ-ਜਾਣ ਹੈ, ਉੱਥੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਗਉਨੈ retains movement or going in this working explanation. All-pervading presence is another explanatory emphasis; the language need not imply a finite traveller crossing from one absent location to another.

rows.en: Every realm is Your dwelling.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਭਵਨ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਲੋਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਭਉਨੈ is read through dwelling, abode or realm. Movement and dwelling stand together without requiring two different Divine beings or a literal street address.

study.focus: Notice how the same universal scope accompanies four different relationships.
study.closeReading: Each line repeats ਕਿ ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ, creating a common frame before the final word changes. Read the changing words slowly: honour, giving, going and dwelling. This helps prevent the universal phrase from making all four lines sound interchangeable. The last pair is especially useful for study because movement and dwelling usually describe different human situations. Here both extend the address beyond a single location. The language can invite reverence wherever life is encountered, without requiring that every person articulate that reverence identically. A practical application is to question why kindness or respect would be reserved for one familiar setting. That application grows from reflection; it is not a fifth translated line.
study.care: The universal devotional language does not erase differences between people or justify coercing agreement. Movement is a poetic description, not a scientific mechanism.
study.reflection: Is there an unfamiliar place or community where your ordinary respect becomes less consistent?
study.teachBack: Name the four changing ideas after ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ and explain why going and dwelling can both belong in the address.

en: Countries, appearances, shining presence and creation are gathered under the word everywhere. Divine presence is not confined to one territory or outward costume, and the stanza ends with the making of all.
pa: ਦੇਸ, ਭੇਸ, ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਰਚਨਾ—ਸਭ ਲਈ ਸਰਬੱਤ੍ਰ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਹੈ। ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਧਰਤੀ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਪਹਿਰਾਵੇ ਤੱਕ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ; ਅਖੀਰਲੀ ਤੁਕ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਵੱਲ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You are present in every land.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਦੇਸੈ concerns lands or places. The universal scope does not make one present-day border, nationality or political claim uniquely sacred; it widens rather than narrows the address.

rows.en: You are present through every outward form.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਭੇਸ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਭੇਸੈ includes attire, guise or appearance. The line concerns presence rather than a judgment that every costume, social role or action is equally wise or harmless.

rows.en: You shine forth in every place.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਰਾਜੈ can carry reigning, abiding or shining presence. This draft selects radiant presence and keeps sovereignty as an alternative; the same stored line receives the same main explanation when it returns in Chhand 116.

rows.en: You bring every form of creation into being.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਰਜਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਸਾਜੈ turns toward making, arranging or creating. It is distinguished from the preceding presence or sovereignty image instead of being collapsed into a second identical claim of rule.

study.focus: Distinguish territory and appearance from the presence and making praised within them.
study.closeReading: The first two lines offer a pair that will return later: ਦੇਸੈ and ਭੇਸੈ. One concerns where, the other how something appears. The next two shift from those settings to radiant presence and creative activity. The rhyme of ਦੇਸੈ and ਭੇਸੈ is not a reason to give them one definition, just as ਰਾਜੈ and ਸਾਜੈ carry different meanings despite their shared sound. When the pair returns at Chhands 114 and 117, its main wording stays constant; new neighbours change the larger discussion, not the source phrase itself. This makes repetition a learning aid. One can recognise the familiar words and then ask what the next pair adds.
words: shining or abiding; reigning is another sense
study.care: The selected sense of ਰਾਜੈ is provisional. Presence in every form does not require ignoring harmful conduct or endorsing every claim to leadership.
study.reflection: How might respect for a person survive a difference in dress, language or nationality?
study.teachBack: Explain the two rhyming pairs without making their meanings identical, and identify which pair will return later.

en: Giving and receiving are placed beside majesty and radiance. The first pair has a genuine alternative reading involving dharam and indwelling, so the lesson names its selected interpretation rather than hiding the uncertainty.
pa: ਦੇਣ ਅਤੇ ਲੈਣ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ। ਪਹਿਲੀਆਂ ਦੋ ਤੁਕਾਂ ਲਈ ਧਰਮ ਅਤੇ ਲੀਨ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਰ ਅਰਥ ਵੀ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਲਈ ਚੁਣਿਆ ਅਰਥ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਅਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤਤਾ ਲੁਕਾਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਗਈ।

rows.en: You give throughout the whole creation.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਦੀਨੈ is provisionally read as giving, paired with taking in the next line. Another commentary reads the Persian deen, dharam or religion. The two analyses are recorded separately; this is not an approved etymological decision.

rows.en: You also receive back from the whole creation.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਵੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਲੀਨੈ is read as taking or receiving in the selected giving-and-taking pair. Indwelling or being absorbed in all is a substantive alternative. A fluent explanation must not conceal that the two readings organise the pair differently.

rows.en: Your majesty is present everywhere.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਜਾਹੋ is read through jaah, dignity, rank or majesty. It should not automatically be treated as the modern command to go somewhere merely because the spellings resemble one another.

rows.en: Your radiance shines throughout all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਭਾਹੋ carries shining, splendour or glory in this context. It is not a measurable claim about physical light intensity and does not require the learner to report an extraordinary visual experience.

study.focus: Learn to state a selected reading and its alternative without mixing them into false certainty.
study.closeReading: This stanza provides a concrete exercise in honest interpretation. Reading ਦੀਨੈ and ਲੀਨੈ as giving and receiving makes the opening a paired movement. Reading them as dharam and indwelling instead joins a religious term with presence. These are not simply different English synonyms. The main draft follows the first pair while exposing the second in the expanded notes. The final two lines then praise majesty and radiance, so neither alternative should cause the rest of the stanza to disappear. A learner can understand the structure of both possibilities without deciding the source edition or grammar. Notice also that receiving back need not imply a human right to take from others; the addressee remains the Divine.
words: giving in the selected reading; deen/dharam is an alternative
taking or receiving here; indwelling is an alternative
study.care: The first pair remains a qualified-review question. Do not turn giving-and-taking imagery into an explanation of a particular person’s loss or a justification for withholding help.
study.reflection: When two interpretations are plausible, what can you understand responsibly before choosing between them?
study.teachBack: Present both readings of the opening pair, say which this draft uses, and explain the two closing images.

en: The familiar pair of every land and every form now leads into time or death and nurture. Repetition allows the same language of presence to frame both the ending of finite life and its care.
pa: ਹਰ ਦੇਸ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਭੇਸ ਵਾਲੀ ਜਾਣੀ-ਪਛਾਣੀ ਜੋੜੀ ਇੱਥੇ ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਵੱਲ ਲੈ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਉਹੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਦੀ ਬੋਲੀ ਸੀਮਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਅੰਤ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਦੋਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘੇਰਦੀ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You are present in every land.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: This stored line is identical to 112.01. Its main English and Punjabi wording is preserved; the following time-and-nurture pair gives it a new local setting.

rows.en: You are present through every outward form.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਭੇਸ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: This stored line repeats 112.02 exactly. The explanation is not rewritten merely to manufacture novelty. Presence in diverse appearances now stands beside mortality and care.

rows.en: You are the power of time and the ending of finite life everywhere.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਅੰਤ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਕਾਲੈ can name time, death or dissolution. It is paired with ਪਾਲੈ rather than treated as the only Divine attribute. The phrase does not predict an individual death or explain why a specific loss occurred.

rows.en: You nurture and sustain life everywhere.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਪਾਲੈ keeps nurture distinct from the preceding ending image. Sustaining language does not mean that food, shelter or medical care are unnecessary, and it promises no immunity from loss.

study.focus: Hear the repeated opening while noticing the new relationship between ending and nurture.
study.closeReading: The first two lines have already appeared in Chhand 112. Their repetition establishes continuity rather than a new definition of ਦੇਸ or ਭੇਸ. What changes is the next pair: ਕਾਲੈ and ਪਾਲੈ. Their near-rhyme brings ending and nurture close together in sound, yet their meanings remain sharply different. Try reading the familiar pair first and then pausing before this new pair. The effect is not to solve the problem of suffering but to broaden the address beyond either comfort alone or destruction alone. For practical reflection, care for a living person remains meaningful even though life is finite. That application should be offered gently, never as a formula imposed on someone in grief.
words: every outward form, as in Chhand 112
study.care: Nothing here warrants blaming grief or illness on spiritual failure. The repeated lines preserve their earlier meanings; the changed context is explained in Study.
study.reflection: How can awareness of life’s limits deepen practical care without turning into resignation?
study.teachBack: Identify the exact repeated opening pair and explain the contrast introduced by ਕਾਲੈ and ਪਾਲੈ.

en: Dissolution, reaching everywhere, diverse appearances and seeing all are brought into one address. The stanza moves from overwhelming power to the breadth of presence and awareness without giving that power to a human observer.
pa: ਸੰਘਾਰ, ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਪਹੁੰਚ, ਅਨੇਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਸੰਬੋਧਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਗੱਲ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਸੂਝ ਵੱਲ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੌਂਪੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ।

rows.en: You are the dissolving power throughout creation.
rows.pa: ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਹੰਤਾ retains destroying or ending rather than being reduced to a pleasant metaphor. Its subject is the Divine; readers receive no permission to harm people they judge to be obstacles.

rows.en: Your reach extends to every place.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੱਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਗੰਤਾ is selected through going or reaching. A knowing-related interpretation also appears in commentary. It should remain visible as an alternative, not silently replace the selected movement sense.

rows.en: You are present in every guise and appearance.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਭੇਖ ਅਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਭੇਖੀ concerns outward forms or attire and recalls ਭੇਸੈ. A visible robe is not proof of wisdom or wrongdoing; the universal image is not an approval of every action performed in a role.

rows.en: You behold all that is.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਵੇਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਪੇਖੀ concerns seeing or beholding. The rhyme with ਭੇਖੀ pairs appearances with the one who sees. It does not give any human institution a spiritual entitlement to surveillance or secret personal information.

study.focus: Distinguish the forms encountered from the seeing that encompasses them.
study.closeReading: The repeated universal phrase is followed by four different endings. The first has a severe sense, the second speaks of reach, and the last pair brings form and seeing into relation. Read ਭੇਖੀ and ਪੇਖੀ together: their similar sound draws attention to a difference between appearance and awareness. The working movement sense of ਗੰਤਾ makes a transition from dissolving power to a reach that is not local; the knowing alternative would shift that transition toward awareness. Naming this choice is more useful than pretending the vocabulary has no uncertainty. Practical study can then ask how quickly we judge by clothing or role, without claiming that a person can acquire the Divine’s all-encompassing sight.
words: destroyer; the one who brings an end
going or reaching in this reading
study.care: Dissolution is not an instruction to violence. All-seeing praise does not authorise intrusion into another person’s privacy or make a human teacher infallible.
study.reflection: What assumption about someone’s character have you made from their outward appearance that deserves a second look?
study.teachBack: Explain the four endings, then describe how ਭੇਖੀ and ਪੇਖੀ relate without giving them the same meaning.

en: Activity and shining presence lead into a contrast between drying away and nourishing. The stanza keeps making, presence, decline and care within the same universal address, without converting those images into predictions about individual events.
pa: ਕਾਰਜ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨਤਾ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਸੁਕਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਲਣ ਦੀ ਜੋੜੀ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਕੰਮ, ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ, ਅੰਤ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਇੱਕੋ ਸਰਬ-ਵਿਆਪਕ ਸੰਬੋਧਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ; ਇਹ ਕਿਸੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਘਟਨਾ ਬਾਰੇ ਭਵਿੱਖਬਾਣੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਦੇ।

rows.en: You are the source at work in every activity.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹਰ ਕਾਰਜ ਦੇ ਮੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਕਾਜੈ concerns work, task or the cause of activity. The paraphrase does not imply that every human decision is right or that responsibility for harmful actions disappears.

rows.en: You shine forth in every place.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੈ।
rows.care: The source line repeats 112.03 exactly. Its main bilingual explanation is retained, with shining or abiding presence selected and reigning kept as an alternative.

rows.en: You draw created things toward drying and dissolution.
rows.pa: ਬਣੀਆਂ ਵਸਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਕਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਸਮੇਟਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਸੋਖੈ has the drying or absorption image already encountered in earlier chhands. It is not ਸੁਖ, comfort. The interpretation keeps decline visible without diagnosing why a particular misfortune happened.

rows.en: You also nourish and sustain what lives.
rows.pa: ਜੀਵਨ ਨੂੰ ਪਾਲਣ ਅਤੇ ਪੋਸ਼ਣ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਵੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਪੋਖੈ conveys nourishing or sustaining and stands in deliberate contrast to ਸੋਖੈ. Neither word should be silently assimilated to the other because their sounds are close.

study.focus: Attend to the contrast in ਸੋਖੈ and ਪੋਖੈ rather than smoothing it into one pleasant idea.
study.closeReading: The first half speaks of activity and presence. The second half brings a sharper contrast: drying or dissolution, followed by nurture. Sound helps connect the lines, but it does not cancel their difference. Read the pair aloud silently in your mind and identify the distinct image in each. The returning ਰਾਜੈ line keeps its established main explanation from Chhand 112, now surrounded by another set of relationships. One useful learning habit is to recognise repeated wording without forcing all repeated passages into identical summaries. Reflection may connect the passage with the impermanence of what we care for, but it should not claim to explain a particular person’s suffering or prescribe indifference to it.
words: shining or abiding presence; reigning is an alternative
study.care: No inference about the moral worth of someone experiencing loss follows from these images. Preservation of a repeated explanation is deliberate, not missing new content.
study.reflection: What can you care for today even though you cannot ensure that it will remain unchanged?
study.teachBack: Distinguish the two closing verbs, and explain how the repeated ਰਾਜੈ line gains context without changing its main meaning.

en: Protection or strength is paired with life-breath, followed by the familiar language of every land and every form. The stanza links what sustains life with a presence that is not restricted by location or appearance.
pa: ਤ੍ਰਾਣ ਜਾਂ ਬਲ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਹਰ ਦੇਸ ਤੇ ਹਰ ਭੇਸ ਵਾਲੀ ਜਾਣੀ ਜੋੜੀ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਆਸਰੇ ਨੂੰ ਅਜਿਹੀ ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਿਆ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਥਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰੂਪ ਨਾਲ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ।

rows.en: You are the protecting strength for all.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਭ ਲਈ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਬਲ ਅਤੇ ਆਸਰਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਤ੍ਰਾਣੈ includes protection, refuge or strength. These related senses need not be reduced to physical force. The address does not guarantee freedom from injury or remove the need for ordinary precautions.

rows.en: You are the sustaining life within all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੈ uses life or vital-breath language. It is not an instruction to hold the breath, alter breathing patterns or treat a medical condition through a special technique.

rows.en: You are present in every land.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: This line repeats 112.01 and 114.01 exactly. Its main wording is preserved, now following the pair about protection and life.

rows.en: You are present through every outward form.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਹਰ ਭੇਸ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: Apart from the stanza counter, this repeats the earlier every-form line. The stored source and its counter remain untouched; only the main explanation is carried forward.

study.focus: Link the first pair about sustaining life with the repeated pair about universal presence.
study.closeReading: The closeness in sound between ਤ੍ਰਾਣੈ and ਪ੍ਰਾਣੈ gives the first two lines their own relationship. Protection or strength is not the same word as life, though each can help illuminate the other. The second pair returns to ਦੇਸੈ and ਭੇਸੈ, which appeared in Chhands 112 and 114. This creates a small network of repetitions across the reading. Rather than treating the repetition as wasted space, use it to compare what surrounds it: creation in one stanza, time and nurture in another, and protection and life here. The reading stays anchored to the exact source lines. A personal application about care is offered separately from their wording, so it does not become a substitute translation.
study.care: Life-breath vocabulary is devotional here, not a clinical claim or breathing prescription. A need for assistance is not a sign of spiritual failure.
study.reflection: Who or what helps sustain your daily life, and what would acknowledging that dependence change in your conduct?
study.teachBack: Distinguish ਤ੍ਰਾਣੈ from ਪ੍ਰਾਣੈ, then compare the repeated closing pair with its earlier settings.

en: Universal honour leads to enduring primacy, remembrance and establishment. The stanza connects reverence with steadiness, while leaving open the interpretive range of what it means for the Divine to be remembered or made manifest everywhere.
pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਮਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਗੱਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨਤਾ, ਜਾਪ ਅਤੇ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਵੱਲ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਅਦਬ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਕਾਅ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹਨ; ਜਾਪਿਯੈ ਦੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਜਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਰਥ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਨੂੰ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਾ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।

rows.en: You are honoured throughout all places.
rows.pa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ।
rows.care: The honour language recalls Chhand 111. The stored form ਮਾਨਿਯੈਂ has its own spelling and hash, which are preserved even though the main sense is closely related.

rows.en: Your primacy endures without passing away.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਇਮ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਸਦੈਵੰ adds enduring continuity; ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨਿਯੈਂ conveys being foremost. This is not a claim that a particular earthly office, organisation or leader deserves permanent authority.

rows.en: You are remembered and invoked everywhere.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਪ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਜਾਪਿਯੈ is selected as remembrance or invocation. Appearing or becoming known is another recorded emphasis. The universal language is praise, not a measured count of everyone’s religious practice.

rows.en: You are established throughout all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਥਾਪਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਕਾਅ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਥਾਪਿਯੈ concerns establishment or steadiness. Together with the preceding line it may relate remembrance to presence; it should not be reduced to erecting one physical object or institution in every location.

study.focus: Notice how the time-word ਸਦੈਵੰ changes a sequence dominated by everywhere.
study.closeReading: Three of the lines repeat the everywhere formula, but the second uses ਸਦੈਵੰ, always. That small change matters: the stanza speaks not only of extent across places but also of enduring primacy. The final pair joins ਜਾਪਿਯੈ and ਥਾਪਿਯੈ, remembrance and establishment in this draft. Another reading of the first emphasises manifestation rather than a devotee’s act of remembering. Keep the selected relation clear while noting that possibility. The stanza offers a study in how a single changed word can affect a repetitive passage. In reflection, steadiness can mean returning to an honest practice, not maintaining a flawless record or claiming that distractions make a person unworthy.
words: remembered or invoked in this reading
study.care: Enduring Divine primacy does not confer permanent human authority. Remembrance is not a competition, attendance score or proof that one community owns the Divine.
study.reflection: What small, freely chosen practice helps you return to attention without turning it into self-judgment?
study.teachBack: Identify the time-word, distinguish it from the repeated place-word, and explain the selected reading of the final pair.

en: Radiance and honour lead into the images of sovereignty and the moon. The stanza uses familiar sources of splendour without reducing the Divine to a physical light or a single mythological figure.
pa: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਇੰਦਰ ਦੀ ਸਰਦਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਚੰਦਰਮਾ ਦਾ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜਾਣੇ-ਪਛਾਣੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਾਲੇ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਵਰਤੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਭੌਤਿਕ ਚਾਨਣ ਜਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਪੌਰਾਣਿਕ ਪਾਤਰ ਤੱਕ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ।

rows.en: Your light is manifest throughout all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਭਾਨੈ supports radiance or manifestation in this address. Light is used devotionally; the line does not specify wavelength, energy, astronomy or an experience that every learner must report.

rows.en: Your greatness is honoured everywhere.
rows.pa: ਹਰ ਥਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਾ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਮਾਨੈ brings honour beside the radiance of ਭਾਨੈ. Honour is not converted into a claim that people have no disagreements about belief or that reverence may be compelled.

rows.en: You are the sovereign presence throughout all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਸਰਬੋਚ ਸਰਦਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ evokes Indra or lordship in a language of sovereignty. Glory is another commentary emphasis. The explanation does not assert that the One is limited to a particular deity’s body or historical king.

rows.en: You are the moon-like splendour throughout all.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਥਾਂ ਚੰਦਰਮਾ ਵਰਗੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਚੰਦ੍ਰੈ retains the moon image rather than replacing it with a generic greatness word. The image belongs to praise and is not a new astronomical claim or a direction to worship the physical moon.

study.focus: Retain the distinct images inside the repeated language of universal presence.
study.closeReading: Each line again has the same universal frame, yet its ending changes the picture. ਭਾਨੈ and ਮਾਨੈ place radiance beside honour; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ and ਚੰਦ੍ਰੈ bring sovereignty and moon-like splendour. The task is not to decide which image alone is the Divine’s true physical shape. It is to notice what each contributes and how the repeated frame prevents any one image from becoming exclusive. The moon image should remain visible even when an explanatory note speaks more generally of splendour. Likewise the sovereign image should not be silently made into a statement about a modern government. Careful study allows a poetic image to do its work without converting it into an empirical claim.
words: Indra image; lordship or sovereign splendour
study.care: These are poetic and devotional images, not measurements or identification of a physical Divine body. They do not establish a human right to demand worship.
study.reflection: Which image helps you notice something you would miss if you used only the word greatness?
study.teachBack: Name all four images and explain why the moon and sovereign pictures should remain distinguishable.

en: Speech, understanding, discernment and mastery of expression form a tightly connected set of praises. The words invite attention to knowledge and communication without suggesting that any human speaker possesses complete wisdom.
pa: ਬੋਲ, ਸਮਝ, ਸੂਝ ਅਤੇ ਕਲਾਮ ਉੱਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀਆਂ ਉਸਤਤਾਂ ਹਨ। ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਵੱਲ ਹੈ; ਕਿਸੇ ਮਨੁੱਖੀ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦਾ ਮਾਲਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ।

rows.en: You are the speaker through whom all expression is possible.
rows.pa: ਸਭ ਬੋਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਭਵ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਆਧਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਕਲੀਮੈ is selected in its speech-related sense, supported by the Arabic-Persian vocabulary reference. A digital English rendering instead gives power. The speech reading fits the closing ਕਲਾਮੈ, but remains a working interpretation, not a corrected source.

rows.en: Your understanding is beyond every limit.
rows.pa: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਮਝ ਹਰ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੀ ਹੈ।
rows.care: ਫ਼ਹੀਮੈ concerns understanding or intelligence, intensified by ਪਰਮੰ. This praise does not rank human worth by test scores, fluency, educational access or cognitive ability.

rows.en: You are discerning and fully knowing.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੂਝ ਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਜਾਣਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਆਕਲ ਅਲਾਮੈ is read as a paired praise of discernment and knowing. The source preserves ਆਕਲ while another text has ਆਕਿਲ. The semantic explanation does not authorise normalising the original spelling.

rows.en: You are the master of speech and expression.
rows.pa: ਤੂੰ ਕਲਾਮ, ਬਚਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਦਾ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੈਂ।
rows.care: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਲਾਮੈ closes the speech-and-knowing cluster. ਕਲਾਮ can include discourse or utterance; it is not confined here to one modern language, and the phrase certifies no particular human statement as Divine speech.

study.focus: Read the first and last speech terms around the two inner descriptions of understanding.
study.closeReading: The stanza can be approached as a frame: ਕਲੀਮੈ and ਕਲਾਮੈ surround ਫ਼ਹੀਮੈ and ਆਕਲ ਅਲਾਮੈ. In the selected reading, expression is related to understanding rather than isolated from it. The vocabulary also shows why similar sounds across chhands cannot receive automatic definitions: ਕਲੀਮੈ here has a speech-related analysis, whereas ਕਲੀ in Chhand 110 was read as fullness of power. The competing power interpretation of this line is recorded, not erased. For practical reflection, the cluster suggests asking whether our speech is informed, attentive and accountable. That is an application to human conduct, not a claim that human speech can attain the complete knowing praised in the stanza.
study.care: Knowledge and eloquence do not make a human teacher infallible. Differences of language or cognitive ability do not diminish a person’s dignity; the source spelling question remains open.
study.reflection: Before speaking confidently, what would help you distinguish what you know from what you are assuming?
study.teachBack: Explain the speech frame and its inner knowing terms, and contrast ਕਲੀਮੈ here with the earlier working sense of ਕਲੀ.
